answer: The grader rubs his oak between his fingers, and the oak must feel dry or the stave will shrink in the barrel. Stave beech barrel finisher hoop warrant rules the rubbing: a warrant beech barrel finishers show after finishing room trials. The oasis is the first rub, made at the pile; the sable is the last, made before the pile is stacked, and the yarrow is the pile itself, dry as a bone. A forger would need 43 false rubs and 43 false piles.
